coverageGaps: No author-recommended Node major is stated in plugin-owned docs; the engines range ^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0 is a declared-support floor and CI pins node-version '24' only as a test configuration, not a proven successful run.

The plugin's own package.json declares no packageManager field, so no author-evidenced package-manager version exists for this plugin; the DSH repository root pins pnpm@11.7.0 for the platform, not for this plugin.

The plugin's documented install path is the Web profile (dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-context, then dsh web); no plugin-owned headless, SDK, or ACP workflow is documented, so those planes are not exercised.

The DeepSeek balance capsule depends on the host settings/credentials services and an outbound /user/balance read; no authenticated integration or credential provisioning is exercised by a generic Web smoke check.
The compat seam matrix requires a dsh checkout (env DSH_REPO) and the release workflow fetches pinned baseline tags; that harness-source staging is not reproduced by a generic smoke run.
The disposable-profile install/uninstall checks are manual per-release verifications recorded in docs/compatibility.md, not automated Radar results.
The plugin's own CI (pr-checks.yml) runs pnpm test and a build smoke; CI configuration is not proof of a successful run.
Radar's bounded Node-major range is 20-40; the plugin's engines range excludes Node 20 and 21, so only 22 and 24 are selectable here.

conclusion.statement: dsh-context@0.61.0 (source tree 0.62.0, artifact sha256 6c250246e5ac13b41683b84ca012153eb08eb40ae8325e6895a94c5abac80e59) was exercised on Node 22 and Node 24 across the three author-declared DSH baselines 0.2.0-rc.2, 0.1.7-rc.2 and 0.1.5-rc.1, in the plugin's only documented plane (Web). 12 tasks executed, 0 failed, 0 deferred, 0 blocked. Web surface results: compatible on 0.2.0-rc.2 (Node 22 and Node 24) and on 0.1.7-rc.2 (Node 22 and Node 24) — the Web host mounted and the declared plugin client entry was published, fetched and materialized, with runtime/artifact/profile/install/registration/host/surface/interaction/shutdown all passed. On 0.1.5-rc.1 the Web profile exited before exposing an HTTP surface on both Node majors (surface-incompatible): the failure is in the harness's own boot path, @deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot@0.1.5-rc.3 throwing 'dsh: user patch-layer watching requires the Cordis HMR service' from watchUserPatches, i.e. a DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 installation-closure defect, not a plugin defect; the plugin's own runtime/artifact/profile/install/registration stages passed and shutdown was clean. Native load checks: compatible on 0.1.5-rc.1 (Node 22 and Node 24) — the exact artifact installed, registered, loaded and satisfied its direct Node peer contracts; on 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.1.7-rc.2 the native result is unknown, not failed: the artifact installed and loaded but dependency coverage is incomplete (4 missing Node peers, 0 indeterminate peers, 0 version facts, 0 unresolved edges). No adapter (SDK/ACP) cells were scheduled, matching the recommendation's web-only executionProfiles. These results are Radar observations of install/load/Web-surface behaviour; they are not a claim of full web-app runtime acceptance, and the author's compatibility table remains an author claim.
